headline: Brazilian Banks Cut 2027 Growth Forecasts, Pressuring Government Spending
summary: Major Brazilian banks downgraded their economic growth forecasts for 2027, reducing expected tax revenues and leaving President Lula with fewer resources for public spending.
why: Downward revisions of economic growth by major commercial banks impact fiscal targets, sovereign risk assessments, and government budgetary planning in Brazil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Lower projected economic growth reduces government tax receipts and constrains fiscal flexibility.
